author: RamSet
releaseNotes: 0.19.6 - Quiets a benign warning that busy multi-sensor thermostats logged often — 'session desynced (decrypt failed) — reconnecting for fresh keys'. That's a normal self-healing re-key (the encrypted connection re-keys and the driver reconnects automatically); it needs no action, so it's now a debug-only message instead of a warning. This update also delivers the engine's recovery-latch fix: a connection that died mid-connect could previously leave the driver stuck 'connecting' and never retry (seen as a device dead for hours) — it now self-heals within one heartbeat. Turn on debug logging if you ever want to see the re-key messages. (0.19.5 added the healthStatus online/offline attribute.)
